name: experiment-report-grader
description: Batch-grade PDF laboratory reports against a confirmed rubric, review them locally, and write approved feedback back into the source PDFs.

agents.label: shared agent root (read by DSH and Codex)

dsh.label: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.notes: Rank ascending decides a name clash: <project>/.dsh/skills (100) > <project>/.agents/skills (200) > customSkillDirs (300) > ~/.dsh/skills (400) > ~/.agents/skills (500). Discovery is exactly one level deep: <root>/<name>/SKILL.md, and nested **/SKILL.md is deliberately not discovered. Frontmatter requires name and description, and an invalid invocation value removes the skill from the catalog entirely.

codex.label: Codex CLI
codex.notes: The current documentation points at $HOME/.agents/skills; ~/.codex/skills (CODEX_HOME) still holds installed skills in practice, so both are registered. Project scope is scanned from the working directory up to the repository root.

workbuddy.label: WorkBuddy
workbuddy.notes: Same product family as CodeBuddy with its own directory name.

codebuddy.label: CodeBuddy Code
codebuddy.notes: Frontmatter additionally understands allowed-tools, context: fork, agent, model and hooks; this skill deliberately stays on the common subset.

claude.label: Claude Code
claude.notes: Personal and project scope are both loaded, and a <skill-name> entry may be a symlink to a directory elsewhere.
